account.title: Add Monitor Account
account.name: Account Name
account.channelUrlHint: Supports @handle, UC channel ID, or full video/playlist URL
account.apiKeyHint: Select a saved API Key, or leave empty to use system default (configured in system settings)
account.webhookHintDefault: Leave empty to use global Webhook config
account.webhookHintTelegram: Telegram Bot Token must be filled in the dedicated field below
account.botTokenHint: Chat ID must be configured in global settings; leave empty to use global Bot Token
account.dingtalkSecretPlaceholder: Starts with SEC, same robot as current Webhook
account.dingtalkSecretHint: If the robot has sign verification enabled in DingTalk admin, fill in SEC; must be the same robot as account-level Webhook URL. Do not fill in if using global DingTalk Webhook only.
account.feishuModeHint: Markdown Card: code-assembled rich text card; Feishu Template: requires creating a card template in Feishu open platform
account.feishuTemplateIdHint: Card template ID created in Feishu multi-dimensional table or open platform
account.feishuScanTemplateIdPlaceholder: Scan confirm card template ID, e.g., $UUID$
account.feishuScanTemplateIdHint: Template ID sent when scan completes (no new videos)
account.enableProxyHint: Both auto-download and manual batch download will use the selected node
account.downloadModeHint: Decides when to use fixed proxy, when to fallback to dynamic proxy
account.downloadModeHelp: Prefer account fixed proxy, fallback to system dynamic proxy when unavailable
account.previewRoutingHint: Will not trigger download, only preview how this account will route in current mode
account.proxyPoolPlaceholder: — Enable proxy first, then select node —
account.proxyPoolHint: Both download paths of the same account share one proxy config to avoid single IP rate limiting

batchDownload.title: Batch Download
batchDownload.cookiePlaceholder: Leave empty to use global config; fill in path accessible by monitor service
batchDownload.cookieHint: Cookie override must be a file path accessible by the monitor server, cannot read browser local files directly.
batchDownload.recentHint: Can recover running tasks, or view completed/cancelled task results.

apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.hint: Each key can have independent daily quota limit. Accounts can choose which key to use. If not specified, system default key is used automatically.

proxyPools.title: Proxy Pool Management
proxyPools.proxyHint: Supports proxy with username/password auth, credentials are encrypted
proxyPools.enableNowHint: Can be linked to accounts after saving
proxyPools.name: Pool Name

dynProviders.title: Dynamic Proxy Providers
dynProviders.emptyDesc: After adding a provider, it will participate in system dynamic proxy routing. Paid providers have priority, free providers as fallback.
dynProviders.addFirstNote: Providers are tried in order from low to high priority
dynProviders.workbenchDesc: Only manages list-pull type providers' refresh / cleanup / run-once, does not affect monitor account scan events. Provider Scheduler does not auto-start, click 'Start Dynamic Proxy Scheduler' to activate.
dynProviders.execHint: Independent of monitor_events · Filter when expanded
dynProviders.localProxyUrlHint: Fill in locally running proxy service address (e.g., Clash, v2ray, etc.)
dynProviders.listAdapterHint: For Geonode official API select 'Geonode'; other JSON APIs can be left empty and configure result path.
dynProviders.supportsAutoDlDesc: Participate in proxy routing for auto downloads
dynProviders.supportsCookieDesc: Can be used for downloads requiring login state
dynProviders.supportsCountryDesc: Can specify exit IP geographic location
dynProviders.supportsStickyDesc: Keep same IP for a period (recommended to enable)
dynProviders.notesPlaceholder: Optional, e.g., service address, account info, etc.

apiKeyForm.title: API Key
apiKeyForm.keyHint: Starts with AIza, create in Google Cloud Console
apiKeyForm.dailyQuotaHint: Daily quota limit for this key, key becomes unavailable when reached

scanConfirm.title: Scan Now
scanConfirm.autoDlHint: Auto-start download after scan completes, max 2 videos simultaneously.

cache.title: API Cache Management
cache.desc: Cache handle → channel_id + uploads_playlist_id, hit = 0 API units. Delete cache to force re-fetch (1 unit).

config.title: Global Settings
config.feishuHint: Account-level URL overrides this global config
config.dingtalkSecretGlobalHint: If global DingTalk robot has sign verification enabled, fill in SEC paired with Webhook; leave empty if not signed. Account-level Webhook still takes priority over account's sign secret.
config.telegramChatIdHint: Target Chat ID, private chat with bot or group ID (negative with prefix)
config.quotaBudgetHint: Used when account has no API Key and system default API Key is also not set; if account or default API Key has daily_quota set, that quota takes priority. Counted in quota units, same as Google Cloud Console (not HTTP call count).
config.timezoneHint: Only affects date boundary for 'by day' aggregation; historical rows keep original date_key.
config.channelMetaTTLHint: After this many days, re-request channel metadata and write back to SQLite. Set 0 for never expire (same as old behavior).
config.notifyOnScanErrorEnable: Enable (works with global or account-level Feishu/DingTalk/Telegram Webhook)
config.notifyOnScanErrorHint: Same account only sends once during cooldown to avoid spam (see next option).
config.scanJitterHint: Random delay 0~N seconds per scan, reduces simultaneous triggers for multiple accounts with same Key. 0 = disabled.
config.quotaAlertThresholdsHint: Comma-separated, e.g., 80,90,100; push when corresponding usage ratio reached (max once per tier per day).
config.channelMetaHealthEnable: Enable (when cache hits, periodically verify uploads_playlist_id via channels.list, ~1 unit/check)
config.notifyChannelMetaMismatch: Send alert to global Webhook on mismatch (Feishu → DingTalk → Telegram priority)
config.defaultApiKeyHint: Used when account doesn't specify an API Key. Add more Keys via 'API Keys' at top.
config.cookiesFileHint: Netscape format (.txt) or JSON format (.json). Leave empty to not use Cookie. Export via browser extension 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY'.
config.downloadPathHint: Save directory for downloaded video files (absolute path)
config.enableAria2Hint: After enabling, all downloads (auto-download on monitor start, auto-download on scan, video detail download selection) use aria2c 16 concurrent connections, significantly improving speed. Requires aria2 installed and in PATH.
config.subLangsHint: When 'Subtitle' is enabled, yt-dlp subtitle languages, comma-separated. Requires cookie file configured to download official subtitles.
config.llmModelHint: Leave empty to use provider default model
config.llmBaseUrlHint: For proxy or self-hosted API endpoints
config.llmMinScoreHint: 1-10 points, only keep clips above this score
config.llmCategoryHint: Different types affect AI topic recognition and scoring weights
config.clipEmbedSubtitle: Soft subtitle embed (MKV container, player toggleable)
config.dynProxyEnableDesc: When account fixed proxy is unavailable, system automatically tries dynamic proxy routes.
config.dynProxyNewAccount: New Accounts Inherit System Dynamic Proxy
config.dynProxyNewAccountDesc: When creating new account, if no fixed proxy bound, automatically select by system policy.
config.dynProxyExistingAccount: Enable System Fallback for Existing Accounts
config.dynProxyExistingAccountWarn: Warning: Enabling will change existing account behavior, please confirm.
config.riskFreeProxyManual: Allow Free Proxy for Manual Download
config.riskFreeProxyAuto: Allow Free Proxy for Auto Download
config.riskCookieNoFreeProxyDesc: Security policy: Cookie downloads don't use free public proxies by default.
config.riskAutoDirectFallbackWarn: Warning: Auto download doesn't allow direct by default, please confirm.
config.maskProxyLogsDesc: Hide proxy exit IP and port
config.dynProviderManageDesc: Add, edit and test dynamic proxy providers (paid/free)
